name: SacCubing IV 2018

venue.name: Placer County Fairgrounds
venue.address: 800 All America City Blvd, Roseville, CA 95678

information: Sacramento's fourth cubing competition is coming up! Make sure to sign up to reserve your spot! Registration fee is $20, and you are permitted to sign up for all available events. The event will be in Johnson Hall within the Grounds, in the same venue as SacCubing III 2018. All competitors must be available/willing to judge/run for the competition.
